name: Ethics and Responsibility
description:
Can we find a part of our own unique happiness through and in connection with the "other"? Can compassion serve as a key to nature? Can we thereby discover common ground with animals?
We begin by analyzing these questions "on the surface" with relevant texts and inspire each other to delve deeper into the current dialogue!
prerequisites: Die Studierenden sollten über Interesse im Bereich der Angewandten Ethik (Bioethik; Tierethik) verfügen.
